QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out at `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`." and "both of those are also off by default."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says THREADING_C is commented out in the shipped config and that THREADING_PTHREAD and THREADING_ALT are also off by default, so a default build defines neither threading macro.
